entries.name: KvUnavailable

entries.signature: export declare const KV_PLUGIN_ERROR_CODES: { /** * `kv()` booted without a configured URL: no `url` option and no `KV_URL`. * * @fix Set `KV_URL`, pass `url`, or use `kv.optional()` for an app that runs without Redis. * @verify bun run test -- src/dot.test.ts */ readonly urlNotConfigured: 'ARKI_KV_PLUGIN_E001'; /** * `probe: true` was set and the set, get and delete round trip at boot failed or timed out. * * @fix Check the URL, the network and the credentials. entries.name: KvDotOptions
entries.signature: export type KvDotOptions = { /** * Redis/Keyv URL. Use `rediss://` for TLS. If omitted, the plugin reads * `KV_URL` from `process.env` (matching the `createKV` factory behaviour). * To defer an env read to boot, prefer thunking the WHOLE options object * — `kv(() => ({ url: env.REDIS_URL }))` — over this per-field thunk * (kept for backwards compatibility). */ readonly url?: string | (() => string | undefined); /** Optional namespace prefix for all keys (defaults to no prefix). */ readonly namespace?: string; /** Optional prefix for rate-limit keys (default `rl`). */ readonly rateLimitPrefix?: string; /** * Skip TLS certificate checks for a `rediss://` URL (default `false`: the certificate is verified). * Turn it on only for a server with a self-signed certificate that you trust. */ readonly allowUnverifiedTls?: boolean; /** * Prove the connection at boot with a set/get/delete round trip (default * `false`). A bad or unreachable URL then fails boot instead of the first * request. The client is closed before the error is thrown. */ readonly probe?: boolean; /** * How long the probe may take, in milliseconds (default `5000`). An * unreachable Redis never answers — the client keeps reconnecting — so * without this limit a bad URL would hang boot instead of failing it. */ readonly probeTimeoutMs?: number; /** How long one command may take before it returns `KvUnavailable`, in milliseconds (default `5000`). */ readonly commandTimeoutMs?: number; };
entries.jsdocSummary: Options for the kv DOT adapter.
